_comment: Anything under overrides beats what the logo says and survives re-running brand:init. Use hex strings. brand, accent and feature are SOURCE colours: their relatives (accent-300, accent-deep, accent-text, surface, ink) are derived FROM them, so pinning one of those three corrects everything downstream too.
_why: brand:init reads a logo and guesses. It guesses well and it is still a guess: it cannot know which colour a school considers its second, only which colours the image contains. Look at brand/preview.html, then pin the two or three it got wrong here. Commit this file. Without it, the next person to clone the repo and run brand:init repaints the site.
